units.source_text: 此左大臣即《梅枝》一回中的左大臣。

en.t: This Minister of the Left is the same Minister of the Left who appears in the chapter The Plum Branch.

units.source_text: 其第三女由源氏提拔，入宫为太子（即今上）妃，称丽景殿女御。

en.t: His third daughter was promoted by Genji and entered the palace as a consort of the Crown Prince, who is now the Emperor, and was known as the Reikeiden Consort.

units.source_text: 后迁藤壶院，改称藤壶女御。

en.t: Later she moved to the Fujitsubo quarters and came to be called the Fujitsubo Consort.
